name: crc32_endpoint
description: Fabric endpoint CRC32 datapath: 32 bits per cycle, zlib/Ethernet compatible (reflected polynomial 0xEDB88320), synchronous clear between frames, valid handshake

ports.name: clear
ports.desc: synchronous state clear, start of a new frame

ports.name: data
ports.desc: one 32-bit word per cycle, bytes LSB-first (little-endian packing)

ports.name: crc_out
ports.desc: CRC32 of all words since clear, valid one cycle after the last word

behavior: State initializes to 0xFFFFFFFF on reset and on synchronous clear.
Each valid word w updates state s to 32 iterations of s = (s >> 1) ^ (0xEDB88320 & {32{s[0]}}) starting from s ^ w.
crc_out registers the updated state XOR 0xFFFFFFFF (the standard final inversion), matching zlib.crc32 of the byte stream.
Latency from valid_in to valid_out is 1 cycle; throughput is one word (4 bytes) per cycle.
